title: Search, filters and saved filters give the same results in all three displays
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view (check in Settings > Roles & Permissions > open your role > Work Orders section). The Admin role has both.
  2. Use a desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  3. In the top bar, choose the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Create everything below in this location.
  4. Make sure the location has the technicians this case uses (e.g. "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards" and "Jenny Wilson"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff record is Active, Clockable is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member > enter the first and last name (e.g. Esther Howard), role Technician, Clockable on, Active, enrolled at this location > Save.
  5. Create the work orders this case uses and set their lead technician (e.g. S1-702 for unit TRK-118 led by Esther Howard, S1-691 for unit TRL-904 led by Ralph Edwards, S1-352 for unit TRL-903 with no lead):
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > choose a customer (e.g. "Fibridge Commercial") and an asset (e.g. unit TRK-118, 2022 Freightliner M2) > Create. Write down the number the build gives the work order (the numbers in this case are examples).
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician (e.g. Esther Howard) and save. Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Click the All tab on the left of the toolbar.
  3. In List, click Search and type a unit number (e.g. TRK-118).
  4. Write down the work orders shown (e.g. S1-702 only).
  5. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (in the design its tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
  6. Write down the work orders shown.
  7. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (in the design its tooltip reads "Board").
  8. Write down the work orders shown.
  9. Clear the search, then turn on Asset on site = Yes (or another filter your work orders differ on) and repeat steps 4 to 7.
  10. Leave the filter on, open Schedule from the top navigation, then click Work Orders in the top navigation.
  11. Note whether the filter is still applied, then do the same round trip once more while in List.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The same work orders appear in List, Tech View and Board View for the same search (example: S1-702 only, 1 result in each).
  • The same work orders appear in all three displays for the same filter.
  • Coming back from Schedule, the filter is kept or cleared in Tech View and Board View exactly as it is in List.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S1-R11, read 8 Oct 2026. Tech plan section 3 ("One filter implementation": List and board share one criteria object).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R11: “Apply existing search, filter persistence, and result-set rules in all three displays.”
